name: minifyjs-bench
description: Benchmark comparison tools for MinifyJS. This package.json exists only to install the JavaScript-based minifiers (esbuild, terser, uglify-js) into bench/node_modules/ so the benchmark suite can find them without requiring a global npm install.

scripts.postinstall: node -e "console.log('Installed:', ['esbuild','terser','uglify-js'].filter(t => { try { require.resolve(t + '/package.json'); return true; } catch { return false; } }).join(', ') || 'none')"
